name: @huddle/game-registry
//description: It is a package of its own rather than a file in game-core because the dependencies point the other way: every Game Module depends on the interface, so the list of installed modules cannot live beside it without a cycle. The TV app, the Controller and the Convex mutations all read it, which is what keeps it out of any one of them.
description: The Registry: the installed Game Modules the hub renders.
//exports: `./logic` is the same games without their screens, for the Convex server. See packages/games/trivia/package.json for why the seam is an entry point rather than a hope about the bundler.
